title: The four hydrocarbon families
caption: Alkanes have only single bonds, alkenes a C=C, alkynes a C≡C, and arenes a benzene ring. Each is shown with four or six carbons so the families compare directly.
alt: Skeletal formulae of butane, but-1-ene, but-1-yne and benzene, with the C=C, C≡C and ring highlighted.
description: Butane: a four-carbon zigzag, single bonds only.
But-1-ene: the same chain with a double bond at one end, highlighted.
But-1-yne: a triple bond at one end, drawn straight.
Benzene: a hexagon with a ring of delocalised electrons.
